question: Does Mei Wending's later received vol5 Yangcheng-or-Nanjing reading establish a historically certain locality/axis for the cited DaTong daylight and sunrise tables?

source.textual_witness: Wikisource public received 欽定四庫全書 recension; the same received Mei work as 13QL, NOT an independent original physical book vote
source.vol5_section: 大統厯依授時立成法下 / 冬至日後每日日出晨分半晝分
source.vol6_section: 釋凡四則 / 存疑 / 第五疑

direct_received_textual_collation.section: 卷五：立成所載日出入半晝夜晨昏分
direct_received_textual_collation.short_literal: 故知為陽城或南京晷刻也
direct_received_textual_collation.normalized_statement: From solstitial daylength and comparisons to regional latitudes, Mei inferred a Yangcheng OR Nanjing possibility; he did not certify one source latitude.

direct_received_textual_collation.section: 卷六：釋凡四則／存疑第五
direct_received_textual_collation.short_literal: 然畢竟此所列者據何地為則也
direct_received_textual_collation.normalized_statement: The same author explicitly leaves the source locality of the transmitted daylength table unknown; the extant entry heading lacks county/province attribution. This qualifies vol5's inference, rather than contradicting an authenticated early instrument.

direct_received_textual_collation.section: 卷六：釋凡四則／存疑第五
direct_received_textual_collation.short_literal: 立成所載日出入半晝分
direct_received_textual_collation.normalized_statement: Mei contrasts a winter-solstice-to-summer-solstice sequential table organized by 盈縮 without 初末 with a 通軌 sunrise/sunset calculation that appears to have 初末 two-figure framing. Their day/limit axes must not be silently merged.

direct_received_textual_collation.section: 卷六：釋凡四則／存疑結語
direct_received_textual_collation.normalized_statement: Mei explicitly reserves adjudication over transmitted differences, supporting unresolved candidate retention, not assigning one location or a mechanical winner.

adjudication.positive: The later received same-author vol6 fifth doubt narrows/qualifies vol5's region inference and separately flags a source time-series axis mismatch. Attribution of the transmitted daylength/source clock stays uncertain even within the cited Qing discussion.
adjudication.reason_no_new_source_entry: Existing 13QL EXT-TIANWEN-13QL-MEI-DATONG-V3-V5-PLACE-RECEIVED already registers the SAME received work/recension; v6 is a newly verified passage within it, not a new independent work or physical source.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: No Mei v5 geographic source hypothesis can be promoted to an authenticated Ming or Yuan direct source-to-region transmission edge.
No direct genealogical edge from a crowdsourced scan-ID index to a specific physical Qing impression.
